page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. The server is powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz with 104 dedicated vCPUs. System memory totals 192.0 GB, yielding a memory allocation ratio of approximately 1.85 GB per vCPU. The hardware profile does not include bundled local disk storage or integrated GPU accelerators.

Network performance is backed by a 32 Gbps baseline bandwidth, enabling reliable data transfers for network-intensive deployments. The absence of local disk drives requires reliance on network-attached block storage, which allows independent scaling of storage capacity and compute resources. Fully dedicated CPU allocation prevents performance degradation caused by shared virtual resource contention.

The ecs.c6t.26xlarge focuses hardware resources on processing core count rather than high RAM capacity or onboard disk arrays. This resource distribution delivers cost efficiency for compute-heavy parallel workloads. Key application fits include high-performance batch processing, software compilation, video encoding, distributed analytics, and scientific simulation.
